laws.rule: A measure similar to the Koror and Airai bul (a traditional leadership decree setting a midnight to 5am curfew) is in effect in this state. Smartraveller says foreigners are unlikely to be the target and that application is inconsistent, but recommends following local authorities and having a genuine reason to be in these areas during those hours.
